title: Do you really need a 4-year degree to build a career in Mass.?
author: Pattie Hunt Sinacole
bullets: Massachusetts employers increasingly value skills and experience over four-year degrees, offering opportunities in various sectors.
Healthcare and skilled trades offer high-demand jobs that don't require a bachelor's degree, possibly warranting state licenses or certificates.
AI and tech changes are prompting employers to prioritize experience, impacting job requirements across many industries in Massachusetts.

title: Mike Vrabel: Drake Maye is not expected to play in preseason opener
author: Khari A. Thompson
bullets: Patriots quarterback Drake Maye is not expected to play in Thursday's preseason opener against the Colts.
Mike Vrabel confirmed the decision to rest Maye, emphasizing preparation and evaluation in joint practices.
Tommy DeVito and rookie Behren Morton are backup quarterback options for the game.

title: Seth Meyers runs Martha’s Vineyard road race with his son
author: Elizabeth Mehler
bullets: Seth Meyers participated in the Chilmark Road Race 5K on Martha's Vineyard with his son Ashe.
Meyers finished fifth in his division, averaging a pace of 7:30 per mile.
Meyers, a frequent visitor to the island, owns a home in Chilmark and was married there in 2013.

title: Explaining the controversy that caused a lengthy delay in the Red Sox-Blue Jays game
author: Hayden Bird
bullets: A rare 'fourth out' rule played a key role in the Red Sox-Blue Jays game, contributing to a 15-minute review delay.
Boston's Anthony Seigler scored a controversial run due to an incorrect scoreboard displaying two outs instead of one.
The Blue Jays failed to appeal at third base, allowing the Red Sox's run to count, despite confusion over the outs.

title: Bicyclist taken to hospital by helicopter after crash with vehicle in North Andover
author: Elizabeth Mehler
bullets: A bicyclist was seriously injured in a crash with a vehicle in North Andover on Monday afternoon.
The incident occurred around 4 p.m. near 100 Turnpike St., with police and fire personnel responding.
The injured bicyclist was airlifted to a regional trauma center; the vehicle's driver was uninjured.

title: This new board game turns the MBTA experience into a game
author: Gwen Egan
bullets: Michelle Dundek from Malden created 'Mass Transit,' a board game based on Boston's MBTA subway system.
The game involves collecting cards while navigating typical MBTA challenges like delays and unexpected events.
Dundek's game went viral with 337,000 views and is inspired by her seven years of riding Boston's T.

title: Suspicious death investigation underway at N.H. mobile home park
author: Ross Cristantiello
bullets: Authorities are investigating a suspicious death in Whitefield, New Hampshire, announced by Attorney General John Formella's office.
Three adult family members were injured and taken to hospitals, with one later pronounced dead.
New Hampshire State Police's major crime unit is leading the ongoing investigation at Hilltop Manor mobile home park.

title: Livestream: Lindsay Clancy murder trial continues with more testimony from psychiatric NP
author: Abby Patkin
bullets: Rebecca Jollotta, a psychiatric NP, testified in Lindsay Clancy's murder trial, detailing her treatment at South Shore Hospital.
Defense seeks to add Emily Thorndike's testimony about McLean Hospital's conditions during holidays; judge takes motion under advisement.
Lindsay Clancy, facing first-degree murder charges, argues postpartum mental illness; prosecutors claim deliberate intent.

title: Local obituary: Max Rothschild, Williamstown 7-year-old
author: Boston.com Staff
bullets: Max Curtis Rothschild, 7, died on August 7 after being hit by a car while riding his bike in Williamstown.
Max, who recently learned to ride a bike, was known for his love of math, chess, and family trips.
Funeral services will be held on August 11 at Congregation Beth Israel followed by a burial in Clarksburg.

title: Former ‘Real Housewives’ star Dorinda Medley lists part of her Berkshires estate, Bluestone Manor
author: Megan Johnson
bullets: Dorinda Medley lists 3.7 acres of her Berkshires estate, Bluestone Manor, for $1.2 million.
The buildable land on West Sheffield Road features private entrance, meadows, woodlands, and mountain views.
Medley aims to downsize, citing excess land and tax expenses as reasons for the sale.
